title: Talent Management Administrator
description:
About the Role:

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Talent Management Administrator to join our global HR team. This role will focus on performance management, manager enablement, compensation administration, and cross-functional HR support. The ideal candidate will have strong problem-solving skills, experience in HR operations, and the ability to support managers in driving performance and development initiatives.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Manage performance review cycles in Teamflect (setup, monitoring, reporting).
  • Maintain training materials and enablement resources for Resource Managers.
  • Support compensation cycles (data validation, SAP updates, bonus letters).
  • Provide HR operational support across performance management, L&D, and compensation.
  • Partner with managers and HR stakeholders to improve processes and adoption.


Qualifications:


  • Experience in performance management programs and manager enablement.
  • Familiarity with HRIS tools (Teamflect, SAP, Payfactors).
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills (Excel pivot tables, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Excellent communication and analytical skills.
  • Experience in global HR operations is a plus.


Why Join Us?


  • Opportunity to work in a global HR function.
  • Exposure to leadership development and succession planning initiatives.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Full remote work flexibility
  • Work with cutting-edge technologies in a dynamic, collaborative team
  • Birthday bonus
  • Independent contractor
  • Access to 500+ lifelong learning courses and development opportunities
  • Fast-track leadership growth paths for senior professionals
  • Open-door policy with a global, inclusive team culture

description:

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Modelar arquiteturas de software em nuvem;
  • Ter conhecimento das tecnologias utilizadas pela equipe;
  • Ter capacidade de medir esforços e definir prazos de implementação;
  • Saber lidar com pressão de prazos;
  • Solucionar problemas que surgem durante os projetos;
  • Habilidade de gerenciar conflitos e expectativas;
  • Proatividade.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Hard Skills:

  • Experiencia com nuvem (AWS, GCP, Azure, etc) (Mínimo de 1 ano);
  • Experiência com .NET (C#) (Mais de 3 anos);
  • Experience com banco de dados relacional (SQLServer, MySql, Postgres) (Mais de 3 anos);
  • Design Patterns;
  • Experiência com testes unitários (TDD);
  • Conhecimento em GIT;
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis (Scrum);
  • Conhecimento em Docker, Kubernets;
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de messageria (Kafka, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ, etc..);
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe;
  • Capacidade de escrever código robusto, testável e validado;
  • Conhecimento em aplicações que precisem responder em alta disponibilidade e alta performance.



Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento de Mercado Financeiro;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Code Quality (sonar);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de APM (Dynatrace, AppDynamics, DataDog, etc...);
  • Conhecimento em Prometheus, metricas e monitoramento;
  • Experiência com aplicações SPA;
  • Conhecimento em ElasticSearch, Apache Lucene e GraphQL;
  • Experiência trabalhando com implantação e gerenciamento de nuvem;
  • Experiência com gerenciamento e implantação de CI/CD.



Soft Skills:

  • Raciocínio lógico e capacidade analítica;
  • Boa Comunicação;
  • Espírito de equipe e capacidade de resolução de conflitos;
  • Ter capacidade de comunicação com diversos perfis de stakeholders;
  • Habilidade de trabalhar em equipes ágeis e multidisciplinares;
  • Criatividade e Proatividade para imaginar diferentes cenários de uso das aplicações;
  • Organização.

title: Server Manager (Global Project) [Inglês Avançado]
description:
Estamos em busca de um Server Manager altamente qualificado para integrar nossa equipe de Enhanced Operation Service (EOS), que faz parte da organização de Enterprise Cloud Services Delivery. Neste papel, você atuará como um consultor de confiança, sendo responsável por salvaguardar e otimizar a entrega de ponta a ponta para clientes estratégicos durante sua jornada de transformação em nuvem.

Você fará parte de um projeto global , integrando um time que atua em uma operação 24x7 para um cliente da Tech Mahindra. Esta é uma posição remota, com alocação mínima prevista de um ano. O horário inicial será de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h, porém a escala é passível de alteração ao longo do projeto para atender às necessidades operacionais.


Principais Responsabilidades

Seu trabalho envolverá uma carga de trabalho mista, com foco em manter a estabilidade e a performance do sistema:

  • Gestão de Incidentes e Problemas: Participar ativamente no tratamento de incidentes críticos (Major Incidents), solucionar falhas em solicitações de serviço e realizar análise de causa raiz (RCA) para interrupções ou problemas de desempenho.
  • Solicitações de Serviço e Mudança: Executar solicitações de serviço e mudanças complexas, gerenciando extensões de tempo de inatividade e incidentes de longa duração.
  • Otimização de Performance: Identificar e liderar iniciativas proativas para melhorar a operação, estabilidade e padronização dos sistemas dos clientes.
  • Suporte Técnico Especializado: Fornecer suporte técnico especializado em Linux e infraestrutura, com foco em solução de problemas de disco, servidor e conectividade de rede.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Otimizar procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs) por meio de automação e definir planos de ação corretiva para atingir os KPIs estabelecidos.
  • Orquestração e Colaboração: Coordenar o trabalho entre diversas unidades de serviços de nuvem, internos e externos, garantindo uma entrega contínua.


Requisitos Técnicos Centrais

  • Expertise em Linux (Obrigatório): Sólida experiência prática em administração de SUSE, Red Hat ou Ubuntu . É essencial ter vivência real em troubleshooting de performance, disco e sistema.
  • Clustering & HA (Obrigatório - Flexível): Experiência de 2 a 3 anos em configurações de Alta Disponibilidade (HA). Conhecimento em Pacemaker é preferencial, mas outras ferramentas de clustering (como Red Hat HA) são aceitáveis.
  • Proficiência em Nuvem (Obrigatório): Experiência prática em pelo menos um dos principais provedores de nuvem pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP . Experiência em ambientes multi-cloud será considerada um diferencial.
  • Redes: Capacidade avançada para diagnosticar problemas de rede em ambiente Linux e nuvem, incluindo TCP/IP, DNS, LDAP, NAT, firewalls e análise de conectividade.
  • Automação: Experiência com linguagens de script (Shell, Python, Go, etc.) e ferramentas de automação de servidores como Ansible ou CHEF .


Qualificações e Experiência

  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo 8 a 10 anos de experiência na área de infraestrutura de TI e operações de servidores.
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Gestão de TI ou áreas correlatas.
  • Idioma: Inglês Fluente é imprescindível, dado que toda a interação com o time global, documentação e suporte ao cliente será realizada em inglês.
  • Habilidades Comportamentais: Foco no cliente, pensamento analítico orientado a soluções e capacidade de adquirir novos conhecimentos de forma independente e proativa.


Imporante:

Inglês é Mandatório.

title: Líder técnico
description:
Vaga: Tech Lead

Estamos em busca de um(a) Tech Lead para atuar como referência técnica, liderando squads e apoiando o desenvolvimento de soluções escaláveis, seguras e de alta qualidade.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Liderar tecnicamente times de desenvolvimento
  • Apoiar definição de arquitetura e padrões técnicos
  • Garantir qualidade de código, boas práticas e evolução das soluções
  • Atuar na resolução de problemas complexos e decisões técnicas
  • Conectar áreas de tecnologia, produto e negócio

Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento e atuação como Tech Lead ou referência técnica
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de aplicações, APIs e integrações
  • Vivência com revisão de código, boas práticas e ambientes ágeis
  • Experiência com pipelines, testes, versionamento e entrega contínua
  • Boa comunicação e perfil colaborativo

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com microsserviços, cloud e arquitetura distribuída
  • Vivência em transformação digital e sistemas de alta volumetria
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade, segurança e governança técnica

Perfil:

Buscamos um profissional com liderança técnica, visão estratégica, perfil hands-on e capacidade de influenciar times e decisões.


Atuação Remoto

Contratação PJ



A Softtek valoriza a diversidade e inclusão em sua força de trabalho. A empresa tem uma equipe global com pessoas de diferentes origens e culturas, o que torna o ambiente de trabalho mais rico e interessante.


Essa oportunidade é preferencialmente para PcD, portanto, todos os profissionais com deficiência podem se candidatar.


Para isso, lembre-se de atualizar seu currículo com o número do CID e com um breve descritivo de sua deficiência para facilitar o processo de recrutamento e seleção.




Os Softtekians são seres humanos talentosos e autodeterminados que se consideram pessoas loucamente incríveis! Venha fazer parte desse time!!!




Quer saber mais? Acesse:





Sobre a Softtek:


Fundada em 1982, a Softtek é uma fornecedora global de soluções de TI orientadas a processos com 30 escritórios na América do Norte, América Latina, Europa e Ásia. Com 15 centros de entrega global nos EUA, México, China, Brasil, Argentina, Costa Rica, Espanha, Hungria e Índia, a Softtek ajuda a melhorar e produzir resultados previsíveis para corporações de primeira linha em mais de 20 países. A Softtek é a criadora e líder da indústria nearshore.

title: Especialista .NET
description:
Sobre a Empresa

Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Engenheiro Especialista de Software


Se você busca atuar em projetos desafiadores, com tecnologias modernas e em um ambiente global, essa oportunidade é para você.


O que buscamos:

Profissional com forte experiência em desenvolvimento backend utilizando .NET (versões 8/9), com visão de arquitetura, boas práticas de engenharia e foco em entrega de valor ao usuário final.


Principais responsabilidades e competências:

  • Desenvolvimento de serviços backend robustos e escaláveis com .NET
  • Atuação com tecnologias frontend como React, Angular ou Blazor
  • Experiência com ambientes em contêineres (Docker/Kubernetes)
  • Conhecimento em design de APIs, integrações e práticas de qualidade para produção
  • Atuação em ambientes multiculturais e distribuídos
  • Interface direta com clientes, apoiando na definição de soluções e direcionamento técnico
  • Experiência com Microsoft Azure e pipelines de CI/CD
  • Conhecimento em mensageria (Kafka/MQTT)
  • Vivência com integrações industriais (shopfloor) ou soluções de IoT

*Inglês fluente (nível C1) para comunicação diária


Perfil comportamental:

  • Autonomia e proatividade
  • Comunicação clara e orientação a resultados
  • Colaboração em times multidisciplinares
  • Capacidade de lidar com requisitos evolutivos

Ambiente de atuação:

Projetos globais, times distribuídos e forte interação com stakeholders internacionais.


Graduação ou nível superior

Certificações são um diferencial.


100% REMOTA


Benefícios:

Vale Refeição - Cartão Swille

title: CAD Software Specialist (FreeCAD/OpenSCAD /LibreCAD) - 64851
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview: We are seeking a CAD Software Specialist to create and document technical models and drawings using open-source CAD tools. The role requires strong attention to detail, structured documentation of modeling workflows, and the ability to produce export-ready technical files.


Requirements

  • Strong English communication skills (written and spoken).
  • Computer with 16 GB RAM or more (mandatory).
  • Ability to operate Linux/Ubuntu in a virtual environment .
  • Proficiency in at least one of the following tools: FreeCAD or OpenSCAD.


Key Responsibilities

  • Create parametric 3D models or 2D technical drawings with proper dimensions and annotations.
  • Produce and export technical files (e.g., STEP, STL, DXF, SVG, PDF ).
  • Demonstrate design progression and parameter-driven changes through intermediate project stages.
  • Submit native project files and structured documentation explaining design intent, constraints, and workflow.


Benefits:

  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : at least 4 hours per day and a total of 40 hours per week with 2-4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract: 16 weeks
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-4 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent automated analytical challenges.
  • Once you clear them, you are ready to go!

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview: We are seeking a CAD Software Specialist to create and document technical models and drawings using open-source CAD tools. The role requires strong attention to detail, structured documentation of modeling workflows, and the ability to produce export-ready technical files.


Requirements

  • Strong English communication skills (written and spoken).
  • Computer with 16 GB RAM or more (mandatory).
  • Ability to operate Linux/Ubuntu in a virtual environment .
  • Proficiency in at least one of the following tools: FreeCAD or OpenSCAD.


Key Responsibilities

  • Create parametric 3D models or 2D technical drawings with proper dimensions and annotations.
  • Produce and export technical files (e.g., STEP, STL, DXF, SVG, PDF ).
  • Demonstrate design progression and parameter-driven changes through intermediate project stages.
  • Submit native project files and structured documentation explaining design intent, constraints, and workflow.


Benefits:

  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : at least 4 hours per day and a total of 40 hours per week with 2-4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract: 16 weeks
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-4 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent automated analytical challenges.
  • Once you clear them, you are ready to go!

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be an active hands-on contributor as well as a strong influencer for our technical direction. You will be able to lead and contribute to significant initiatives as well as provide mentorship through code reviews and pairing.

We are especially excited to hear from you if you are enthusiastic about working in the luxury retail/e-commerce space or passionate about our mission to create a circular economy for high-end goods.

This role reports to the Engineering Manager of Customer Experience and will be fully remote.


What You Bring To The Role

- 5+ years professional software development experience

- Fluency with either Elixir or Ruby

- Proficient with the latest versions of ECMAScript (JavaScript) as well as HTML and CSS

- Experience with React and common tools used in the wider React ecosystem, such as Node.js and npm

- Familiarity with common programming tools such as IDEs, RESTful APIs, Git repositories, TypeScript, version control software, and remote deployment tools

- Familiarity with event-based architectures, database fundamentals and GraphQL

- Enthusiasm for solving problems for our users with technology

- Curiosity about retail/e-commerce , the high-end consignment market, and/or how to create a sustainable, circular economy for luxury goods.


Bonus Points

Experience with Kafka for event-streaming

Experience extracting microservices from a monolith


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Fonoaudiólogo
description:
Venha impactar vidas com a gente!


Se você busca crescimento profissional e deseja atuar em uma empresa com propósito , essa oportunidade é para você!


A Comunicare Aparelhos Auditivos é o varejo do Grupo WSA , líder mundial na indústria de aparelhos auditivos. Nosso propósito é impactar vidas por meio de uma reabilitação auditiva de excelência , devolvendo o prazer de escutar e melhorando a qualidade de vida de milhares de pessoas.


Estamos presentes em mais de 100 lojas no Brasil e também no Chile, México e Argentina , com atuação sólida, inovadora e em constante expansão.


Quer fazer parte de uma empresa que muda histórias todos os dias?

Confira nossas oportunidades e venha crescer com a gente!


Sobre a oportunidade:

Estamos em busca de um Fonoaudiólogo para atuar com atendimento a clientes, realização de exames e adaptação e venda de aparelhos auditivos.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Realizar atendimento ao cliente
  • Realizar testes relacionados ao uso de próteses auditivas
  • Ajustar as próteses auditivas de acordo com a audiometria do cliente
  • Inspecionar e enviar aparelhos auditivos para manutenção
  • Venda e pós-venda


O que buscamos:

  • Graduação concluída em Fonoaudiologia
  • Interesse em atuar com aparelhos auditivos
  • Habilidade com tecnologia: pacote office e sistemas gerais


Benefícios:

  • Pacote de benefícios completo e diferenciado, pensado para proporcionar mais tranquilidade e qualidade de vida, sem impacto financeiro para o colaborador.


Informações adicionais da vaga:

  • Locais: Belém PA, Anápolis GO, Londrina PR, Rio Grande-RS, São Paulo-SP e Coberturas MG.
  • Modelo: presencial
  • Jornada: 40 horas semanais
  • Regime: CLT | Efetivo



Também temos oportunidades em outras localidades!

title: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack
description:
We're Hiring: Senior Software Engineer | Remote from Brazil | Fluent English required


Location : Remote – Brazil only

Contact: PJ - Long Term


We are looking for a kind, curious, and experienced Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) who enjoys solving challenging problems and building impactful user experiences. You’ll join a collaborative and supportive engineering team focused on making it seamless and compelling for users to engage with our platform.

This is a fully remote role reporting to the Engineering Manager of Customer Experience, with strong opportunities for technical leadership, mentorship, and personal growth .


What You’ll Do

  • Write high-quality, scalable, and testable code that drives key business initiatives
  • Contribute hands-on while also helping shape the technical direction of the team
  • Build and maintain features using modern technologies such as:
  • Elixir, Ruby
  • React, TypeScript, GraphQL
  • Kafka, AWS (Lambda)
  • PostgreSQL, DynamoDB
  • Participate in architecture and design decisions
  • Review pull requests and provide constructive feedback
  • Collaborate closely with teammates through pair programming
  • Deploy and monitor user-facing features in production
  • Continuously learn and explore new technologies and patterns


What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience
  • Strong proficiency in Elixir or Ruby
  • Solid experience with modern JavaScript (ES6+), HTML, and CSS
  • Hands-on experience with React and its ecosystem (Node.js, npm)
  • Familiarity with:
  • RESTful APIs
  • Git and version control workflows
  • TypeScript
  • Remote deployment tools
  • Understanding of event-driven architectures , databases , and GraphQL
  • A problem-solving mindset with a focus on user impact
  • Interest in e-commerce, retail, or building sustainable digital ecosystems


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Kafka (event streaming)
  • Experience transitioning from monoliths to microservices architectures


Why Join Us

  • Work with a supportive and collaborative team that values growth
  • Have real influence on technical decisions and product direction
  • Be part of a mission-driven environment focused on innovation and sustainability
  • Continuous opportunities for learning, mentorship, and career development

description:
Operador de Reservas – Turismo Internacional – Remoto

Remuneração: R$ 3.700,00 | Modalidade: 100% Remoto

Empresa: Oparks Travel


✈️ Você domina o inglês e ama criar roteiros incríveis?


Sobre a Oparks Travel

Somos especialistas na distribuição de produtos turísticos internacionais, com foco em excelência no atendimento e soluções completas para agências de viagens. Buscamos profissionais comprometidos, apaixonados por turismo, com olhar atento aos detalhes e alta capacidade de organização.

  • Realizar reservas de hotéis, passeios, transfers, ingressos e outros serviços turísticos.

  • Atualizar sistemas de reservas e contribuir com sugestões para melhoria dos pacotes.
  • Colaborar com os times comercial e de operações de forma integrada.

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. title: Automotive Account Manager
description:
What you’ll do


  • Manage and develop assigned customer accounts and ensure achievement of sales, profitability, and performance targets.
  • Prepare and negotiate quotations for RFQs, costing and pricing, ensuring alignment with agreed margin levels.
  • Identify and win new profitable business within the account.
  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships and support company image.
  • Monitor market trends and competitor activities to identify new opportunities.
  • Analyse profitability and implement appropriate actions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional collaboration with customers to resolve issues efficiently, enhance satisfaction, and drive company targets.
  • Develop sales strategies, plans, and budgets for customer accounts.
  • Track business opportunities, reporting , and account performance.
  • Support team development, define KPIs, and monitor performance.
  • Improve sales and quotation processes and ensure efficient operations.


Your profile


  • Degree in business, engineering, or a related field.
  • Min. 3 years of experience in B2B sales management in automotive environment.
  • Understanding of the wire harness products and market is a strong plus.
  • A confident communicator with strong negotiation and relationship-building skills.
  • Customer-focused with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
  • Analytical thinker with the ability to turn insights into actions.
  • Self-driven, with the ability to take initiative and lead cross-functional collaboration.
  • Professionally resilient and adaptable to the market changes and challenges.
  • Proactive, with a growth mindset and results‑driven approach.
  • A team player who thrives in a dynamic, international environment.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (Brazilian).


What we offer


  • A dynamic, international environment where your impact truly matters.
  • Real ownership of accounts and the opportunity to shape customer strategy.
  • Career growth opportunities and the chance to develop leadership skills.
  • Collaboration with global teams and leading industry customers.
  • Competitive compensation, benefits package & company car.

title: Automotive Account Manager
description:
What you’ll do


  • Manage and develop assigned customer accounts and ensure achievement of sales, profitability, and performance targets.
  • Prepare and negotiate quotations for RFQs, costing and pricing, ensuring alignment with agreed margin levels.
  • Identify and win new profitable business within the account.
  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships and support company image.
  • Monitor market trends and competitor activities to identify new opportunities.
  • Analyse profitability and implement appropriate actions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional collaboration with customers to resolve issues efficiently, enhance satisfaction, and drive company targets.
  • Develop sales strategies, plans, and budgets for customer accounts.
  • Track business opportunities, reporting , and account performance.
  • Support team development, define KPIs, and monitor performance.
  • Improve sales and quotation processes and ensure efficient operations.


Your profile


  • Degree in business, engineering, or a related field.
  • Min. 3 years of experience in B2B sales management in automotive environment.
  • Understanding of the wire harness products and market is a strong plus.
  • A confident communicator with strong negotiation and relationship-building skills.
  • Customer-focused with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
  • Analytical thinker with the ability to turn insights into actions.
  • Self-driven, with the ability to take initiative and lead cross-functional collaboration.
  • Professionally resilient and adaptable to the market changes and challenges.
  • Proactive, with a growth mindset and results‑driven approach.
  • A team player who thrives in a dynamic, international environment.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (Brazilian).


What we offer


  • A dynamic, international environment where your impact truly matters.
  • Real ownership of accounts and the opportunity to shape customer strategy.
  • Career growth opportunities and the chance to develop leadership skills.
  • Collaboration with global teams and leading industry customers.
  • Competitive compensation, benefits package & company car.

resolution? Magentrix, a leading provider of Partner Relationship Management (PRM) and Customer

Portal solutions, is seeking a Technical Support Specialist to join our growing team!

outside the box and deliver outstanding customer support. This role combines solution engineering

expertise with creative problem-solving to ensure our customers get the most out of their Magentrix

experience.

Provide expert-level technical support for Magentrix software, troubleshooting issues and

isolating root causes

problems eƯiciently

and eƯiciency

customer service at every interaction

knowledge base articles

Salesforce Administration

Customer Success experience

title: Back End Developer With Data Exp
description:
Role: Data Engineer III (API) or Software Engineer with Data Experience

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Mode: Contract


About the Role

We are looking for a senior-level engineer with strong backend and data expertise. The role centers on Node.js, TypeScript, APIs, and database modeling with exposure to cloud services.


Responsibilities

  • Build and manage APIs (REST & GraphQL).
  • Design and optimize data models (MongoDB, NoSQL, relational).
  • Work on schema design, indexing, and transactions.
  • Develop ETL pipelines and data ingestion workflows.
  • Collaborate on backend architecture with containers and cloud (AWS/OCI).


Requirements

  • 6+ years of software/data engineering experience.
  • Strong skills in Node.js, TypeScript, and database modeling .
  • Experience with GraphQL, MongoDB, and NoSQL.
  • Knowledge of software engineering best practices.
  • Cloud (AWS/OCI) and container experience.
  • Excellent communication skills.


Nice to Have

  • Messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
  • Event-driven architecture.

title: Desenvolvimento Salesforce Pleno/Sênior (Digital Engagement)
description:
Já conhece a GFT?

Com mais de 40 anos de mercado e localizada em 20 países, a GFT emprega mais de 18.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo quase 5.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Pleno/Sênior que atue com Salesforce (Digital Engagement)



Responsabilidades:

Desenvolvimento Salesforce

  • Desenvolver funcionalidades na plataforma Salesforce Service Cloud.
  • Criar e evoluir soluções utilizando Apex.
  • Desenvolver componentes utilizando Lightning Web Components (LWC).
  • Criar e manter Flows para automação de processos.

Digital Engagement

  • Apoiar implementações de Digital Engagement, incluindo:
  • Chat
  • WhatsApp
  • Bots

Omnichannel & Atendimento

  • Configurar e ajustar Omni-Channel Routing para distribuição de atendimentos.

Integrações

  • Desenvolver integrações com sistemas externos utilizando:
  • APIs REST
  • APIs SOAP

Qualidade e Suporte

  • Apoiar atividades de troubleshooting e análise de logs.
  • Garantir aderência às boas práticas da plataforma Salesforce.
  • Garantir conformidade com governor limits.

DevOps e Entrega

  • Participar de deploys e versionamento de código.
  • Colaborar com o time técnico na evolução contínua da solução.


Requisitos Técnicos:

Plataforma Salesforce

  • Experiência com Salesforce Service Cloud.

Desenvolvimento

  • Experiência com Apex.
  • Experiência com Lightning Web Components (LWC).

Automação

  • Experiência com Salesforce Flows.

Integrações

  • Experiência com integrações via:
  • REST
  • SOAP

Atendimento Omnichannel

  • Conhecimento em Omni-Channel Routing.

Digital Engagement

  • Noções ou experiência com:
  • Chat
  • WhatsApp
  • Bots

Plataforma

  • Conhecimento sobre governor limits da plataforma Salesforce.


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;

title: Assistente financeiro
description:
MILHAS PLUS BUSCA TALENTO!

Estamos em busca de um Assistente Financeiro comprometido e proativo para se juntar à equipe da MilhasPlus. Este cargo envolve realizar atividades financeiras diárias, controle de contas a pagar e a receber, reconciliação bancária e suporte na preparação de relatórios financeiros. Haverá interação com diferentes departamentos para garantir a precisão de dados e processos financeiros. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e será desempenhado remotamente.


Necessário para assumir a vaga: ter disponibilidade para trabalhar no domingo 100% homeoffice

Qualificações

  • Habilidades analíticas e financeiras: Capacidade de realizar análises financeiras, experiência em conciliação bancaria, controle de contas a pagar e a receber e interpretar dados financeiros.
  • Faturamento e contabilidade: Competência no processo de emissão de notas fiscais, conciliação bancária e em atividades básicas de contabilidade.
  • Comunicação: Excepcionais
  • Diferencial:

Sistema de ERP , prestação de contas, DRE.


Contratação: Formato PJ

100% homeoffice - 50 horas semanais 

Salário: Salário base + Metas gerais+ individual

Benefícios : Gympass

Salário base: R$3.000


Empresa em expansão com grande chances de crescimento, muitas oportunidades de fazer renda extra com o conhecimento adquirido.

title: Nutricionista
description:
VAGA EXCLUSIVA PARA NUTRICIONISTA.


Estamos em busca de um nutricionista que tenha paixão por compartilhar conhecimento e transformar vidas por meio da educação em saúde natural.


O profissional ideal terá habilidade de comunicação, experiência na criação de conteúdos em vídeo e aulas, e interesse em crescer junto com a Mahile, ampliando nossa presença nas redes sociais.


Responsabilidades


Realizar gravações de aulas, vídeos e campanhas institucionais;

Participar da criação e revisão de conteúdos científicos e educativos sobre suplementação e saúde natural;

Atender pacientes ou clientes em consultas individuais, conforme a demanda;

Representar a Mahile como autoridade em saúde;

Contribuir com ideias e feedbacks para o desenvolvimento de novos produtos e protocolos.


Qualificações


Formação superior;

(desejável);

Experiência em atendimento clínico e conhecimento em suplementação e nutrição;

Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;

Conforto diante das câmeras e experiência em gravações de vídeo.


Requisitos


Disponibilidade para gravação de vídeos e aulas em ambiente profissional;

Comprometimento com prazos e entregas;

Interesse genuíno por saúde natural e educação em bem-estar;

Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe de forma remota;

Autorização para uso de imagem, voz e nome nos conteúdos da marca durante o período de contrato.

title: Senior Customer Education
description:
About the Role


Our education platform is a central learning hub for both customers and internal teams. With a large and growing base of users, we’ve reached a point where we need to scale the program more intentionally — with more structured learning paths, meaningful certifications, and content that directly connects to product adoption and retention.

We are looking for someone who combines strategic vision with strong execution skills: someone who can design an end-to-end educational program and turn it into measurable business results.


Key Responsibilities

  • Define the architecture of the education program — learning paths, certifications, and journeys aligned with the customer lifecycle and different user profiles
  • Develop and maintain courses and learning paths with high instructional quality and strong alignment with the product, in both Portuguese and English
  • Script educational videos and collaborate with recording and editing teams to ensure production consistency
  • Create and execute engagement strategies to convert users into active learners and drive progression through learning paths
  • Define and monitor program KPIs — activation, completion, and active engagement — connecting learning behavior to retention and expansion metrics
  • Turn usage data into portfolio decisions: what to prioritize, update, or discontinue
  • Collaborate with Product, Customer Success, and Support teams to keep content up to date and identify knowledge gaps that impact adoption
  • Support internal enablement initiatives


Requirements

  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in customer education, instructional design, or e-learning — preferably in B2B SaaS
  • Experience managing educational programs within LMS platforms (not just operating them, but designing structure and analyzing data)
  • Ability to connect learning behavior to business metrics such as adoption, retention, and expansion
  • Experience scripting and producing educational videos independently
  • Fluent communication in Portuguese and English — able to create and script content in both languages
  • Familiarity with AI tools applied to educational content production workflows


Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in B2B SaaS
  • Experience with Product-Led Growth (PLG) and Sales-Led Growth (SLG) models
  • Experience with product education and scalable learning programs
  • Experience with user reactivation strategies or engagement management in educational programs
  • Strategic use of AI to optimize content production, curation, and updates

title: Dispatcher
description:
Our client is a growing nationwide network of home service experts on a mission to bring world-class service to every American household with the utmost convenience. The company is committed to providing convenient, comprehensive, and ‌professional home services to families nationwide. They are guided by values of customer obsession, an execution-first approach, and an \"invent and simplify\" mentality.


We are currently seeking a skilled and motivated Dispatcher/HR to coordinate and oversee daily cleaning and service schedules by assigning cleaners, confirming client readiness, and ensuring quality service delivery. The Dispatcher acts as the link between customers, cleaners, and management, ensuring smooth daily operations, proper documentation, and customer satisfaction. 


Key Responsibilities:  

  • Prior experience in dispatch, scheduling, or logistics.
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
  • Excellent communication with both customers and field staff.
  • Ability to manage stress and resolve scheduling conflicts in real time.
  • Proficiency in BookingKoala CRM, OpenPhone, RingCentral, and Google Workspace.
  • Attention to detail with clock-in/out monitoring, photo uploads, and reports.
  • Ability to hire, train, and oversee service providers.
  • English fluency; Spanish preferred (Los Angeles/Miami markets).
  • Flexibility to cover evenings and weekends as required.


DUTIES


Scheduling & Daily Dispatch


  • Assign daily jobs to cleaners in BookingKoala.
  • Monitor same-day jobs to ensure start times are met.
  • Confirm cleaner clock-in/clock-out and require before/after photos.
  • For Airbnb clients: collect damage reports, supply alerts, and before/after pictures.
  • Verify next-day schedules with both clients and cleaners.
  • Maintain updated cleaner calendars (minimum two weeks ahead).


Customer & Cleaner Support


  • Answer incoming calls and resolve service-related questions.
  • Provide cleaners with clear instructions (special notes, supplies, reporting requirements).
  • Handle reschedules and urgent client requests.
  • Conduct Happy Calls after cleanings to confirm satisfaction.


Sales & Overflow Coverage


  • Take incoming sales calls when CSR is unavailable.
  • Send quotes and update CRM as needed.
  • Support upselling and follow-ups when covering evening/weekend shifts.


Hiring & Onboarding


  • Conduct weekly recruiting campaigns (e.g., Care.com and other sources).
  • Call at least 15 leads per week and conduct 6+ interviews.
  • Onboard 3–5 qualified cleaners weekly across Los Angeles (Pacific Time) and Miami (Eastern Time).
  • Send onboarding emails and guides, set up training schedules.
  • Collect W-9 forms and proof of insurance from all regular providers.
  • Develop and update provider SOPs and training materials.


Quality & Performance Management


  • Review provider performance, verify documentation, and ensure SOP compliance.
  • Identify top performers and support bonus/recognition processes.
  • Escalate and resolve quality issues promptly.


Reporting & Communication


  • Update daily scorecards for Los Angeles and Miami.
  • Provide Slack updates summarizing daily dispatch results.
  • Attend HSA Sales/Training calls.
  • Document missed calls and unresponsive customers in shared sheets.


Systems & Process Management


  • Maintain a dedicated phone line for cleaner communication (separate from client and lead lines).
  • Continuously improve onboarding, communication, and SOP processes.

title: Business English Teacher
description:
Help Brazilian Executives Find Their Voice in English


You know that moment when a student finally nails a presentation they were terrified of? Or closes a deal they almost lost to a language barrier? That's what we do at YouAble — and we're looking for teachers who live for those moments.


We teach Business English 1:1 to executives across Brazil. No scripts. No generic curricula. Each student gets a learning path built around their actual job, their actual challenges, their actual goals.


The role:

  • Individual classes (30 or 60 min), ~25 per week
  • Track each student's progress and adapt constantly
  • Work closely with our coordination team on methodology


The deal:

  • R$ 60/hour (contractor)

#LI-LR1

#LI-REMOTE

  • Buscar e aplicar feedbacks para melhoria contínua, mantendo postura colaborativa e proativa.

Experiencia:

  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud;
  • AMPscript e SSJS;
  • Construção de Custom Activity, Jornadas e Automações;
  • Import e Export de dados no Marketing Cloud;
  • Edição de Criativos e scripts;
  • Criação de Data Streams, Data Models, Calculated Insights, Segmentação e Ativação no Salesforce Data Cloud.


Conhecimento:

  • Data Cloud;
  • Modelagem, governança e desenvolvimento Data Cloud e Marketing Cloud;
  • Modelagem de Dados (Entidade e relacionamentos);
  • SQL Avançado;
  • Consumo de APIs;
  • Construção de Cloud Pages;
  • Capacidade de troubleshooting em integrações, automações, APIs e scripts;
  • Familiaridade com práticas de governança de dados, de duplicação e identificação no Data Cloud.


Soft Skills:

  • Capacidade de fazer apresentações para públicos qualificados como Líderes de Produto e de Tecnologia
  • Capacidade de engajar pessoas de negócio e de disciplinas conectadas para a tomada de decisão e evolução do tema;
  • Perfil \"comunicação que aproxima\": Diminuir barreiras, construir pontes e manter alinhamento e transparência nas ações em um ambiente remoto/online;
  • Perfil \"Data-driven\": Tomada de decisão baseada na análise profunda de dados;
  • Perfil \"Vai lá e faz\": sempre que é necessário, coloca a mão na massa e resolve;
  • Liderança;
  • Organização.

14º e 15º salários fixos;

Participações nos Resultados (conforme a senioridade);

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico sem coparticipação,

Programas de bem-estar com Wellhub (antiga Gympass), Nutrição, Psicologia, Laboral, Massagem, Grupo de corrida e academia local;

Vale Alimentação e Vale Refeição – com flexibilidade de % nos cartões VA/VR, sem coparticipação;

title: Senior Studio Specialist
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Senior Studio Specialist at JoVE , you will drive the operational excellence of our in-house creative studio. You will execute and oversee project execution, optimize workflows, and introduce AI-powered solutions to enhance efficiency, quality, and scalability.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who understands the full creative production lifecycle and thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment - a love for science is a plus!


Responsibilities:

  • Oversee and coordinate the execution of creative projects from brief to final delivery
  • Maintain the studio production schedule and assign projects to the in-house motion graphics team based on availability, timelines, and project scope.
  • Track the day-to-day progress of projects in the pipeline, follow up on deadlines, flag delays, and ensure workload distribution supports on-time delivery.
  • Define and track KPIs, deadlines, and performance metrics to ensure smooth production cycles
  • Work closely with the Director of Marketing to translate business objectives into actionable creative plans
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to refine briefs and propose effective design solutions
  • Create and edit high-quality video assets to support marketing campaigns, product launches, digital initiatives, and brand awareness efforts.
  • Design, document, and continuously improve studio workflows and cross-functional processes
  • Ensure brand consistency and creative quality standards across all deliverables
  • Identify bottlenecks and implement scalable improvements to increase efficiency
  • Lead the integration of AI technologies into creative workflows, including automation, asset generation, project tracking, and quality optimization


Requirements:

  • 5–7 years of experience in creative production, studio coordination, or motion graphics environments
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent creative projects while ensuring quality and on-time delivery
  • Strong experience supporting and improving production workflows within creative teams
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate designers and balance workloads effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficiency with project management tools such as Asana (or similar platforms)
  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools to improve production efficiency and creative output
  • Strong attention to detail and quality control across all stages of the creative process
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders
  • Solid understanding of the end-to-end creative production lifecycle (briefing, design, review, revisions, final delivery)


Why Join JoVE?

  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Senior Studio Specialist at JoVE , you will drive the operational excellence of our in-house creative studio. You will execute and oversee project execution, optimize workflows, and introduce AI-powered solutions to enhance efficiency, quality, and scalability.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who understands the full creative production lifecycle and thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment - a love for science is a plus!


Responsibilities:

  • Oversee and coordinate the execution of creative projects from brief to final delivery
  • Maintain the studio production schedule and assign projects to the in-house motion graphics team based on availability, timelines, and project scope.
  • Track the day-to-day progress of projects in the pipeline, follow up on deadlines, flag delays, and ensure workload distribution supports on-time delivery.
  • Define and track KPIs, deadlines, and performance metrics to ensure smooth production cycles
  • Work closely with the Director of Marketing to translate business objectives into actionable creative plans
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to refine briefs and propose effective design solutions
  • Create and edit high-quality video assets to support marketing campaigns, product launches, digital initiatives, and brand awareness efforts.
  • Design, document, and continuously improve studio workflows and cross-functional processes
  • Ensure brand consistency and creative quality standards across all deliverables
  • Identify bottlenecks and implement scalable improvements to increase efficiency
  • Lead the integration of AI technologies into creative workflows, including automation, asset generation, project tracking, and quality optimization


Requirements:

  • 5–7 years of experience in creative production, studio coordination, or motion graphics environments
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent creative projects while ensuring quality and on-time delivery
  • Strong experience supporting and improving production workflows within creative teams
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate designers and balance workloads effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficiency with project management tools such as Asana (or similar platforms)
  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools to improve production efficiency and creative output
  • Strong attention to detail and quality control across all stages of the creative process
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders
  • Solid understanding of the end-to-end creative production lifecycle (briefing, design, review, revisions, final delivery)


Why Join JoVE?

  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

Location: Brazil (Remote)

title: Technical Project Manager - Cloud
description:
Job Title: Technical Project Manager

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Employment Type: Full Time


Key Responsibilities

• Should have executed large scale Cloud Migrations, SQL, Windows, Apps services, AVS, AVD Migrations or Integrations and Transformations.

• Prepare, track, and manage project schedules, ensuring timely delivery.

• Drive project/program management activities across multiple cloud consulting and migration initiatives.

• Collaborate with stakeholders including clients, offshore teams, and cross-functional groups to deliver transformation goals.

• Oversee governance, project status reporting, and cadence reviews with leadership and internal stakeholders.

• Identify, track, and resolve issues, risks, and escalations across projects.

• Ensure projects are delivered on-time, within budget, and aligned with organizational objectives.


Must Have Skills

✔ 15+ years of experience in cloud transformational consulting and migration projects.

✔ Proven track record of executing large-scale Cloud Migrations, Integrations, and Transformations.

✔ Strong background in Infrastructure (Virtualization, Cloud technologies, compute, storage, networking).

✔ Expertise in planning and managing multiple stakeholders including client, offshore, and cross-functional teams.

✔ Experience with DC migration to Cloud.

✔ Demonstrated ability to drive major IT projects, manage multiple priorities, set timelines, hold teams accountable, and deliver on time and within budget.


Good to Have Skills

• Strong communication skills with effective stakeholder management.

• Excellent time management, prioritization, and organizational skills.

• Experience working with tight deadlines and handling escalations.

• Ability to manage governance, collate project status reports, and present to leadership teams.

• Experience in weekly cadence reviews and reporting to internal stakeholders.

• Ability to track and report schedule and cost variances across projects.

• Skilled in identifying issues, risks, and driving them to closure or mitigation.


Certifications (Preferred)

• Agile Management

• PRINCE2 / PMP (Preferred)

• Other program management certifications


Tools & Technologies (Good to Have)

• ADO or other project management tools

• Azure Cloud

• Databases

• Networking

• Virtualization

• Public Cloud


Educational Qualification

• BCA / MCA / BE / BTech or equivalent

title: Especialista em Engenharia de Software Backend - Java/Inteligência Artificial
description:
Se você é uma pessoa que é gente boa, gosta de aprender e é apaixonada por resultados, você está no lugar certo! Como maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, queremos construir um ecossistema cada vez mais forte, com pessoas que gostem de inovar e acreditem na colaboração para fazer a diferença!


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

Atuar como referência técnica do time, liderando e apoiando na modelagem de soluções especialistas para segmento Agro, assim como o desenvolvimento e a evolução de soluções de software, dados e implementação de IA, garantindo qualidade técnica, sustentabilidade arquitetural e entrega contínua de valor ao negócio. Ser o elo entre o segmento Agro e o time de IDeIA da TOTVS, bem como integração e alinhamento com o time de Framework e Engenharia, apoiando nas discussões para evoluir a arquitetura, ferramentas e uso de IA dentro da TOTVS.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ

● Referência técnica do time de desenvolvimento, apoiando decisões de design, arquitetura e implementação;

● Atuar de forma hands on no desenvolvimento de soluções complexas, mantendo proximidade com o código e com os problemas reais do produto;

● Traduzir requisitos funcionais e não funcionais em soluções técnicas viáveis, avaliando alternativas e escolhendo as soluções tecnológicas mais adequadas;

● Contribuir ativamente para a evolução da arquitetura das aplicações, dados e integrações;

● Garantir a adoção de boas práticas de engenharia de software, como testes automatizados, versionamento, revisão de código, documentação e integração contínua;

● Apoiar a construção e evolução de pipeline de dados, integrações assíncronas e soluções que se conectem a modelos de IA quando aplicável;

● Atuar como ponto de referência técnica para o time, promovendo mentoria, troca de conhecimento e evolução da maturidade técnica;

● Participar de discussões técnicas com produto, dados e áreas parceiras, apoiando decisões táticas e operacionais;

● Identificar oportunidades de melhoria técnica e propor soluções que aumentem eficiência, confiabilidade e qualidade do produto;

● Criar ou evoluir componentes reutilizáveis, padrões e frameworks/plataforma quando necessário para acelerar o desenvolvimento;

● Apoiar a priorização técnica do backlog, sinalizando riscos, dependências e impactos arquiteturais;

● Contribuir para a evolução dos processos de engenharia, alinhados aos objetivos de curto e médio prazo da área;

● Assegurar o cumprimento das metas do time, influenciando práticas, priorização de tarefas e promovendo evolução contínua da qualidade técnica;


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

● Arquitetura de software moderna, cloud native, microsserviços e orientada a eventos;

● Experiência comprovada em IA e LLMs, uso via API, prompts, RAG e integração de IA em aplicações;

● Padrões como RAG, fine-tuning, agentes inteligentes;

● Otimização de custos e latência em aplicações com IA;

● Experiência na stack de desenvolvimento Java e Spring Boot atuando como Arquiteto de Software;

● Versionamento com Git / GitFlow e/ou Azure DevOps;

● Design Patterns, Clean Code e princípios de engenharia de software;

● DevOps: CI, CD, Git, GitFlow, Docker, Kubernetes e infraestrutura como código;

● APIs REST e boas práticas de API First;

● Segurança no desenvolvimento e práticas de DevSecOps;

● Mensageria, RabbitMQ ou equivalentes;

● Experiência de +8 anos em desenvolvimento de software, com vivência como referência técnica, arquiteto ou liderança técnica de times.

● Experiência na stack de desenvolvimento Java e Spring Boot atuando como Arquiteto de Software;

● Versionamento com Git / GitFlow e/ou Azure DevOps;

title: IT SAP Support Coordinator
description:
Hello, candidate :)


About Us: Würth IT, a dynamic and forward-thinking IT organization within the Würth Group, is growing its team in Brazil. We are looking for dedicated professionals to join us as part of our global network, working together to deliver cutting-edge IT solutions that enhance security, efficiency, and reliability. As a member of the Würth IT team, you’ll collaborate with colleagues worldwide, providing specialized support and promoting the innovative IT services we offer. Your work will play a crucial role in strengthening the operations of Würth Group companies across the globe, driving impactful results within a supportive and growth-oriented environment.


Your main activities:

We are seeking a Local SAP 2nd & 3rd Level Support Coordinator to work at our site in Cotia, São Paulo.

You will be part of an international and innovative team that values diversity, development, and collaboration. This role involves working closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, scalable, and high-performing commerce applications.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead and develop the local SAP 2nd & 3rd Level Support Team
  • Work operational 50% of the available time in resolving 2nd LS tickets
  • Ensure compliance with local requirements (labor law, office presence, local processes)
  • Responsible for salary and contract matters, local onboarding processes, and employee well-being
  • Support local personnel development and feedback processes
  • Manage and monitor KPIs and SLAs in SAP support
  • Promote innovation and continuous improvement within the team
  • Act as an interface to internal and external stakeholders
  • Work closely with the functional manager to align technical goals and feedback loops
  • Foster team spirit and local corporate culture


Requirements:

  • Fluent in English.
  • Willingness to work at least 3 days per week on site in Cotia.
  • At least 5 years of professional experience in the SAP environment
  • Deep technical knowledge in one of these areas: SD, WM/EWM, MM or FI
  • Proven experience in leading teams, ideally in a local context.
  • Experience in stakeholder management and working with international teams
  • Knowledge of ITIL and agile methods is a plus
  • Strong communication skills, empathy, assertiveness, and intercultural competence

title: Analista de Processos (Scrum Master) - Júnior
description:
Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.


Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.


Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.


Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:


Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Engajamento: Na Bluesoft, atuamos com energia, buscamos a excelência e assumimos a responsabilidade coletiva para crescer juntos e alcançar grandes resultados.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.


Sobre a vaga:


Na Bluesoft , o Analista de Processos (Scrum Master) tem o papel de impulsionar a eficiência e a colaboração entre times, garantindo que nossas entregas aconteçam com clareza, consistência e alinhamento às necessidades dos clientes. Buscamos alguém que seja facilitador, analítico, comunicativo e apaixonado por criar ambientes de trabalho saudáveis e colaborativos


Principais atividades:

  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (Daily, Planning, Retrospectiva, Review e Refinamento).
  • Monitorar riscos, identificar gargalos e apoiar o time na tomada de decisão para manter o fluxo de entrega.
  • Acompanhar prazos e demandas junto aos times e áreas envolvidas, apoiando a gestão de projetos quando necessário.
  • Dar visibilidade às métricas e indicadores de performance (ex.: Lead Time, Throughput, Bugs, Previsibilidade).
  • Atuar de forma proativa em situações críticas, ajudando na análise de alternativas e planos de ação sustentáveis.
  • Garantir que as retrospectivas resultem em ações práticas, com responsáveis e acompanhamento contínuo.
  • Manter e atualizar a documentação de processos, propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Facilitar o alinhamento entre áreas (Produto, Desenvolvimento, QA, Implantação e Processos).
  • Apoiar onboarding de novos integrantes do time e organizar feedbacks para fortalecer a comunicação e aprendizagem.
  • Prover diagnóstico de causa-raiz e múltiplas opções estratégicas para a solução de impedimentos críticos, garantindo que a decisão final seja informada e eficaz.
  • Atuar como um agente de challenge e facilitador de melhorias, questionando processos ineficientes, estimativas não realistas ou decisões que possam comprometer a previsibilidade e a qualidade da entrega
  • Disseminar a cultura ágil, promovendo autonomia, colaboração e evolução contínua.


Requisitos Indispensáveis:

  • Experiência prática com Scrum , Kanban e fundamentos de Lean .
  • Habilidade em comunicação, empatia e facilitação de grupos.
  • Visão sistêmica e capacidade de analisar processos ponta a ponta.
  • Organização e disciplina para acompanhamento de tarefas, ações e métricas.
  • Postura proativa e orientada a soluções, atuando como agente de mudança.
  • Desejo de construir um ambiente colaborativo, transparente e que estimule aprendizados constantes.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão (ex.: Jira, Azure DevOps, Miro).
  • Experiência com times de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Certificações ágeis (CSM, PSM, KSD, KSI ou similares).

title: Oracle EPM Technical Consultant
description:
We are looking for an experienced Oracle Cloud EPM Technical Consultant to design, develop, integrate, and support Oracle Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) Cloud solutions.

description:
Job Title: Back-End Engineer / Platform Engineer (GraphQL & Node.js)

Location: Brazil / Remote

Employment Type: Contract

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Back-End / Platform Engineer to design and build scalable, data-driven APIs and backend services. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in GraphQL, Node.js, and TypeScript , along with experience in cloud-native and containerized environments.


Mandatory Skills

  • GraphQL
  • API Development (GraphQL & REST)
  • Node.js
  • TypeScript

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain data-driven APIs using GraphQL and REST
  • Build and optimize backend services interacting with relational and NoSQL databases
  • Design and manage GraphQL schemas, resolvers, and performance optimization
  • Collaborate with data, product, and application teams to define data access patterns
  • Implement API security, versioning, and governance best practices
  • Deploy and manage services using Docker and Kubernetes
  • Work with cloud platforms (AWS or OCI) to build scalable and reliable systems
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize application and database performance
  • Participate in architecture discussions and mentor junior engineers

Required Skills & Experience

  • 6+ years of experience in software engineering or backend development
  • Strong hands-on experience with API development (GraphQL & REST)
  • Solid understanding of database design and optimization (SQL & NoSQL)
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure - OCI)
  • Hands-on experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Proficiency in at least one backend language: Node.js (preferred), Java (Spring Boot), or Python
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills

title: Analytics Architect
description:
Role: Analytics Architect

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Mode: Full Time


Responsibilities:

Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of advanced analytics solutions using Azure Databricks/ Fabric. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of big data technologies, data engineering, and cloud computing, with a strong focus on Azure Databricks along with Strong SQL.

Work closely with business stakeholders and other IT teams to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.

Oversee the end-to-end implementation of data solutions, ensuring alignment with business requirements and best practices.

Lead the development of data pipelines and ETL processes using Azure Databricks, PySpark, and other relevant tools.

Integrate Azure Databricks with other Azure services (e.g., Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory) and on-premise systems .

Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the data engineering team, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

Ensure proper documentation of architecture, processes, and data flows, while ensuring compliance with security and governance standards.

Ensure best practices are followed in terms of code quality, data security, and scalability.

Stay updated with the latest developments in Databricks and associated technologies to drive innovation.


Essential Skills:

Strong experience with Azure Databricks , including cluster management, notebook development, and Delta Lake.

Proficiency in big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark) and data processing frameworks (e.g., PySpark).

Deep understanding of Azure services like Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, and Azure Data Factory. Power BI, SSRS, SSAS, PSKU to F SKU.

Experience with ETL/ELT processes, data warehousing, and building data lakes.

Strong SQL skills and familiarity with NoSQL databases.

Experience with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems like Git.

Knowledge of cloud security best practices.


Experience:

Demonstrated expertise of 12+ years in developing data ingestion and transformation pipelines using Databricks/Synapse notebooks and Azure Data Factory.

Solid understanding and hands-on experience with Delta tables, Delta Lake, and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2.

Experience in efficiently using Auto Loader and Delta Live tables for seamless data ingestion and transformation.

Proficiency in building and optimizing query layers using Databricks SQL.

Demonstrated experience integrating Databricks with Azure Synapse, ADLS Gen2, and Power BI for end-to-end analytics solutions.

Prior experience in developing, optimizing, and deploying Power BI reports.

Familiarity with modern CI/CD practices, especially in the context of Databricks and cloud-native solutions.

title: 1st Level Tech Support Agent
description:
Bookmap is a market depth visualisation and high-speed trading platform, providing complete market transparency and incomparable insight into the actions and intentions of equities, futures, and crypto traders.

Built to help traders make informed decisions, gain competitive advantage, and ensure consistent success, it has become the industry-leading software for order book and order flow analysis.


We are currently looking to hire a 1st Level Tech Support Agent , to join our growing team and cover US time zones.


Responsibilities


This role is 100% remote and includes shifts


As a 1st level customer support agent, your tasks will focus on looking after, supporting and advising our international customers from the crypto/stocks/futures trading environment.


You will receive functional and technical inquiries and faults via the live chat, by e-mail and occasionally by telephone, process them independently or forward them to the right contact person conscientiously.


Required skills and experience

  • Background in Computer Science, Economics, Finance or other related field
  • Experience in the area of customer support, ideally for software products
  • Technical interest in complex software is desirable
  • Good command of the English language, both written and verbal
  • Solution-oriented
  • Structured way of working 
  • Team spirit
  • Commitment


The below would be considered an advantage

  • Interest or experience in trading financial instruments(crypto, futures, etc)
  • A second foreign language


What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment
  • Paid annual leave and sick leave
  • Equipment and software reimbursement, with flexible options to suit your needs
  • Opportunities for professional development, including language courses and training programs
  • A collaborative, international team and a supportive work culture


The hiring process consists of 3 steps:

1.After applying, successful candidates will be asked to answer a short questionnaire

2.Those who pass the first stage will be required to complete a paid test task

3. Interview with our team

title: Solutions Architect – Data Services
description:
Job Title: Solutions Architect – Data Services

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Through December 2026 (Possibility of Extension)

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: EST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect – Data Services to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-scale data solutions for a global consulting environment. This role is responsible for defining end-to-end architectures across modern data platforms, ensuring alignment with business objectives, governance standards, and enterprise architecture principles.


The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Azure Databricks , data engineering, and cloud-native architectures, along with hands-on experience in data mesh , data products , and Unity Catalog–based governance . This is a hands-on architect role , requiring both strategic thinking and practical execution through proof-of-concepts (POCs) and close collaboration with engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities


Solution & Data Architecture

  • Define and own solution-level architectures across data platforms, with a focus on Azure Databricks (workspaces, compute, orchestration).
  • Design and implement data mesh architectures and domain-oriented data products.
  • Establish governance frameworks using Unity Catalog , including security, lineage, and multi-workspace strategies.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready data solutions.
  • Identify cross-system dependencies, integration points, and architectural risks.


Data Platform Design & Governance

  • Define best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and serving within Databricks.
  • Establish standards for data product ownership, contracts, and lifecycle management.
  • Implement enterprise-grade security and access control using Unity Catalog, Entra ID, and cloud-native tools.

description:

We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of “large company” in 2018. We now have more than 350 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria , as well as projects in more than 20 countries. Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years.


Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. Working with Affinity is a “Lifetime Experience ” where you will have the opportunity to demonstrate all your potential and to be successful on every level.


#welcometoyourfuture


What you need to have

  • College degree in IT Engineering, Computer Science, or similar;
  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering or related roles;
  • Strong experience with data pipeline design and development (batch and streaming);
  • Proficiency in Python and/or Scala for data processing;
  • Experience with SQL and relational/non-relational data modeling;
  • Experience with big data frameworks (Apache Spark, Kafka, Airflow, or similar);
  • Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms (Azure Data Factory, Databricks, AWS Glue, Redshift, or similar);
  • Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and lakehouse architectures;
  • Familiarity with data governance and data quality practices;
  • Excellent English skills (C1/C2);
  • Availability to relocate to Portugal.


Nice to have

  • Familiarity with real-time/streaming architectures (Kafka, Flink);

title: Customer Service Technical Support
description:
Company Description

Kyniska is a leading provider of innovative HR solutions, connecting talented individuals with exciting job opportunities worldwide. Our dedicated consultants collaborate with top companies globally, offering industry insights while mentoring and training candidates. Every day, we help over 200,000 professionals achieve fulfilling careers tailored to their skills and aspirations. At Kyniska, we are committed to enabling professional growth and creating impactful employment connections.

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Customer Service Technical Support professional. Responsibilities include delivering exceptional customer support, ensuring customer satisfaction, and enhancing customer experience through proficient problem-solving and communication. The individual will handle customer inquiries via phone, email, or chat, troubleshoot technical issues, and work diligently to resolve customer concerns while maintaining professional and empathetic interaction.

Qualifications
  • Strong skills in Customer Service and Customer Support, ensuring the ability to manage and resolve client inquiries efficiently.
  • Expertise in Customer Satisfaction and Customer Experience, with a focus on delivering solutions to improve customer relationships.
  • Proficiency in Phone Etiquette and effective communication skills, providing a professional and empathetic approach to customer interactions.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while being a collaborative team player.
  • Problem-solving aptitude and a keen attention to detail, especially in handling technical customer issues.
  • A background in IT, technical support, or related fields is a valuable asset.
  • Experience using CRM or help desk software is a plus.

title: Data Project Manager (remote)
description:
A Brunel está apoiando uma empresa referência em soluções de dados e analytics na busca por um(a) Gerente de Projetos de Dados .


Essa pessoa terá um papel estratégico na condução de iniciativas end-to-end — desde a fase de discovery até o go-live — atuando como ponte entre áreas técnicas e de negócio. O desafio envolve liderar projetos complexos de dados, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade, dentro do prazo e alinhadas aos objetivos da organização.


Buscamos um perfil que una forte experiência em gestão de projetos com repertório técnico em dados, capaz de navegar com autonomia entre stakeholders, engenharia e decisões de arquitetura.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Liderar projetos de dados de média e alta complexidade (data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, BI, migração de dados, entre outros).
  • Definir e gerenciar escopo, cronograma, orçamento, recursos e riscos.
  • Conduzir cerimônias ágeis (dailies, sprints, retrospectivas) e adaptar frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, híbrido) conforme o contexto.
  • Atuar como interface entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio, traduzindo demandas em planos de execução claros.
  • Monitorar KPIs de projeto (velocity, burn-down, progresso) e comunicar status para diferentes níveis da organização.
  • Antecipar riscos, dependências e gargalos, propondo planos de mitigação.
  • Gerenciar fornecedores e parceiros envolvidos nas entregas.
  • Garantir documentação estruturada de processos, decisões e aprendizados.
  • Impulsionar melhoria contínua nas práticas de gestão de projetos da área de dados.


Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada (5+ anos) em gestão de projetos de tecnologia, sendo ao menos 2 anos em projetos de dados ou analytics.
  • Conhecimento prático do ecossistema de dados: data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, modelagem de dados e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Qlik, Tableau ou similares).
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis e tradicionais (Scrum, Kanban, PMBOK/Waterfall), com flexibilidade de aplicação.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão (Jira, Azure DevOps, Monday, Asana ou similares).
  • Forte habilidade de gestão de stakeholders e comunicação executiva.
  • Capacidade de interpretar documentação técnica (arquitetura, modelos de dados, integrações).
  • Inglês fluente (interação constante com times e stakeholders internacionais).


Diferenciais

  • Background técnico prévio (Data Analyst, Data Engineer ou BI Developer).
  • Experiência com cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP).
  • Uso de soluções de IA como aceleradores de entrega.
  • Conhecimento em SQL para validações básicas.
  • Vivência com change management em contextos data-driven.
  • Conhecimento em governança de dados (ex: DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Certificações (PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, PSM, SAFe ou similares).
  • Experiência com gestão de portfólio e priorização estratégica.
